# Vendored OpenCL headers

These are unmodified Khronos OpenCL-Headers at commit
`4ea6df132107e3b4b9407f903204b5522fdffcd6` (tag `v2024.10.24`).
They are build-time headers only; the runtime driver is loaded dynamically
(`libOpenCL.so`) and is not redistributed.

- `CL/cl.h`
- `CL/cl_platform.h`
- `CL/cl_version.h`
- `OpenCL-Headers-LICENSE` (Apache License 2.0)

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-Headers
